sentence: This project provides computer tools and expert help for analyzing large sequencing datasets in genomics, metabolomics and proteomics research.
This project studies how genes are controlled and what a certain molecular pathway does in esophageal adenocarcinoma.
This project studies choanoflagellates to find out how they sense their environment and how their sensory systems evolve.
This project tries to restore sympathetic nerves in the heart and finds out how this prevents cardiac arrhythmias after myocardial infarction.
This project studies how lower sphingolipid metabolism in brain blood vessels affects blood vessel function in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how the blood proteins fibrinogen and fibrin differ in structure and how fibrinogen changes into fibrin.
This project studies how a transcription factor helps control gene expression through chromatin.
This project studies how clonal evolution leads to malignancy and shapes the response to cancer therapies, using patient samples and preclinical models.
This project builds a cell culture method to isolate cancer stem cells from tumors and uses them to engineer 3D vascularized tumors.
This project develops a way to use extracellular vesicles to deliver genes that silence HIV expression in infected cells.
This project studies how drinking contexts and risks change for young adult drinkers before and after the legal drinking age.
This project provides isolated cells, animal models and molecular tools for liver research.
This project uses baboon tissue samples to study how genes are regulated and compares gene regulation between humans and baboons.
This project uses mice with a human immune system to study the genetic causes of the destruction of insulin-producing cells.
This project uses gene targeting and gnotobiotic technology to study how alpha defensins shape the microbiome and the response to pathogens.
This project provides bulk, single-cell and spatial profiling to study how vaccination and other interventions act against the HIV viral reservoir.
This project studies amygdala circuits behind emotional responses to sounds and how experience, sex and hormonal state shape their activity.
This project builds a model system from human cells that copies working and faulty connectivity of the human brain.
This project uses animal models to study how the endolysosomal system contributes to brain injury after stroke.
This project studies how the chemosensory systems of insects work, since insects use them to find human hosts, food and mates.
